title: Thinking on Designing Spaces (and changing your mind)
summary: Divya describes her resistance to designing the home she shares with Gaurav — flute on the counter, marble that needs mats, all the small frictions that quietly steer behaviour — and Kahran walks her through how the spaces he's designed shape what people actually do in them. They reach for the Japanese idea of wabi as the breath a space holds, talk about complicated vs complex problems, and land on Divya needing heuristics rather than a recipe.
topics: designing the spaces you live in
wabi as the breath of a space

intents.display: to think about how the space you live in shapes what you do in it
